featured_reviews.review_text:
I would strongly advise looking elsewhere for your event catering. Dealing with Labbaik Caterers was an incredibly frustrating experience from start to finish.
The most glaring issue is the management’s attitude. They are dismissive, unprofessional, and frankly, quite rude when you ask for basic updates. Instead of providing solutions or reassurance, they act as if you are inconveniencing them by expecting the service you paid for.

A Culinary Delight: Meher Catering Review

I recently had the pleasure of ordering from Meher Catering, and I must say, the experience was nothing short of exceptional. We ordered a variety of dishes, including Chicken Dum Biryani, Mutton Dum Biryani, Mutton Kebab, and Cheesy Kebab, and each one exceeded our expectations.

Food Quality:

The food from Meher Catering was truly amazing. The biryanis were cooked to perfection, with fluffy basmati rice, tender meat, and a blend of spices that was both aromatic and flavorful. The kebabs were equally impressive, with the mutton kebabs being particularly tender and juicy. The cheesy kebabs were a nice surprise, with a delightful balance of creamy cheese and spicy meat.

Service: 5/5

The service from Meher Catering was top-notch. The ordering process was seamless, and the staff were friendly and responsive to our queries. The food was delivered promptly, and the packaging was secure and convenient.

Value for Money: 5/5

Considering the high quality of the food and the generous portion sizes, Meher Catering offers excellent value for money. The prices are reasonable, and the catering service is perfect for special occasions or large gatherings.

Verdict

Meher Catering is a must-try for anyone looking for delicious, authentic Indian cuisine. With its exceptional food quality, top-notch service, and excellent value for money, Meher Catering is sure to impress even the most discerning palates.

Price*: Reasonable (around ₹500-₹1,000 for a meal for 4-6 people)

Recommended for*: Special occasions, large gatherings, and anyone looking for authentic Indian cuisine.

Will I return?
Absolutely, to try more of Meher Catering's delicious dishes and experience their exceptional service once again.

featured_reviews.name: Azania Thomas
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Kaizad Patel — what can I say? There truly aren’t enough words to encapsulate the sumptuous wedding food he prepared for our reception. The experience was nothing short of unforgettable.

From the very beginning, Kaizad was accessible, professional, and instinctively understood exactly what a wedding crowd would love — from the starters right through to the main course. He is a culinary genius with an extraordinary eye for detail.

The care, precision, and attention to detail were evident not only in the flavours but also in the service and presentation. Every dish was served with clockwork timing, thoughtfulness, and respect for the occasion. The coordination, calm service flow, and seamless execution made guests feel truly looked after.

The patra nu macchi was absolutely delectable — with the perfect balance of spice and sweetness in the chutney, beautifully wrapped and steamed in a banana leaf. The pulao daal had just the right thickness, wholesomeness, and warmth. The sali jardalu(apricot) chicken was rich, comforting, and perfectly textured. The lagan nu custard was nutty, gently cinnamony, and deeply satisfying. One can go
on..

A particularly thoughtful touch was the bhonas, which were sent promptly between 2–4 pm on the day of our reception to guests who were unwell or unable to attend. That level of care meant so much, and everyone who ate his food had a truly memorable experience.

The thali selection was outstanding and thoughtfully inclusive for vegetarian and Jain guests. Having undhiyu available in winter was a rare and wonderful treat, and the overall spread was exceptional. In fact, a few people told us they came to the wedding especially for his food — which says it all!

Kaizad also caters for Navroz, weddings, and other festive occasions. If you’re looking for unforgettable wedding or festive catering, his cuisine is simply unmatched.
